split_policy_change.rule: A blind_test dataset is rejected if either its lexical path or its resolved path is inside the repository root.
split_policy_change.regression: A repository file outside evaluation/cases remains ineligible even when a supplied registry claims complete blind-test provenance.

quality_gate.ruff_command: uv run ruff check backend tests evaluation
quality_gate.compile_command: uv run python -m compileall -q backend evaluation tests

read_only_runtime_audit_on_base_commit.sse_streaming_limitation: The API awaits the complete agent response before emitting start/delta events; this is chunked delivery after completion, not model token streaming.
limits: Snapshot/catalog-only; no Groq provider call or live inventory check.
No real Redis, browser/network end-to-end, same-session concurrency, production SLO, or human-rated answer-quality test.
The existing servers on ports 8000 and 5173 predated the base commit and were not attributed to this checkout.
